meta.title: 5 Stoic lessons for taming your ego

beats.text: Five Stoic lessons for keeping your ego in its place.
One. You are not your opinions. Stop defending them as if they were your life.
Two. Ego wants to be seen as good. Character just quietly tries to be good. Feed the second one.
Three. Praise and blame both live outside you. Don't move into either and call it home.
Four. The need to look right is the very thing that stops you from becoming right.
Five. Stay a student. The moment you crown yourself a master, you quietly stop growing.
Marcus ruled the world and still wrote to himself in secret. That is what a tamed ego looks like.
